questions.prompt: Two particles $A$ of mass $2\text{ kg}$ and $B$ of mass $3\text{ kg}$ are connected by a light inextensible string passing over a smooth fixed pulley. The system is released from rest with $B$ at a height of $1\text{ m}$ above horizontal ground. Particle $B$ descends and hits the ground, where it remains at rest.

parts.label: a
parts.prompt: Find the speed of particle $A$ at the instant $B$ hits the ground, and determine the additional height particle $A$ ascends before coming momentarily to rest.

questions.prompt: A block $A$ of mass $2\text{ kg}$ is moving along a rough horizontal table where the coefficient of friction is $0.3$. At a certain instant, the string pulling $A$ becomes slack, and $A$ continues to slide with an initial speed of $3\text{ m s}^{-1}$.

parts.label: a
parts.prompt: Calculate the deceleration of block $A$ while the string is slack, and find the distance $A$ travels before coming to rest.

questions.prompt: A particle $P$ of mass $1.5\text{ kg}$ is moving up a smooth plane inclined at $30^\circ$ to the horizontal. At the instant the string attached to $P$ becomes slack, $P$ has a speed of $4\text{ m s}^{-1}$ directed up the plane along the line of greatest slope.

parts.label: a
parts.prompt: Find the acceleration of $P$ parallel to the plane while the string is slack, and calculate the distance $P$ travels up the plane before coming momentarily to rest.

questions.prompt: A particle $A$ is moving vertically upwards at $5\text{ m s}^{-1}$ at the instant the string connected to it becomes slack. A horizontal ceiling is located $1.2\text{ m}$ directly above the position where the string became slack.

parts.label: a
parts.prompt: Determine whether particle $A$ reaches the ceiling, and if so, calculate its speed at the instant it hits the ceiling.

questions.prompt: Two particles $A$ and $B$ lie on a smooth horizontal surface and are connected by a slack light inextensible string of length $2.5\text{ m}$. Initially, the separation between $A$ and $B$ is $1.0\text{ m}$. Particle $A$ is projected to the left with constant speed $1.2\text{ m s}^{-1}$ while particle $B$ is projected to the right with constant speed $1.8\text{ m s}^{-1}$ along the same straight line.

parts.label: a
parts.prompt: Write an expression for the separation of the particles at time $t\text{ s}$, and find the time elapsed before the string becomes taut.

questions.prompt: A particle $A$ is moving vertically upwards with a speed of $3\text{ m s}^{-1}$ at the instant the connected particle hits the ground and the string goes slack. Particle $A$ moves freely under gravity until it returns to the level at which the string became slack.

parts.label: a
parts.prompt: Calculate the time taken for particle $A$ to reach its highest point, and find the total time elapsed from the instant the string became slack until $A$ returns to its initial level.

questions.prompt: Two particles $A$ of mass $1\text{ kg}$ and $B$ of mass $3\text{ kg}$ are connected by a light inextensible string passing over a smooth fixed pulley. The system is held at rest with both string sections vertical, and $B$ is at a height of $0.9\text{ m}$ above horizontal ground. The system is released from rest. When $B$ hits the ground, it remains at rest and does not rebound.

parts.label: a
parts.prompt: Find the acceleration of the system while the string is taut, and calculate the tension in the string.

parts.label: b
parts.prompt: Find the speed of $B$ at the instant it hits the ground, and calculate the additional height particle $A$ rises after $B$ hits the ground.

questions.prompt: A block $A$ of mass $2\text{ kg}$ rests on a smooth horizontal table. It is connected by a light inextensible string passing over a smooth pulley at the edge of the table to a hanging particle $B$ of mass $3\text{ kg}$. The system is released from rest with $B$ at a height of $0.75\text{ m}$ above horizontal ground. When $B$ hits the ground, it remains at rest, the string becomes slack, and block $A$ immediately enters a rough section of the table where the coefficient of friction is $0.30$.

parts.label: a
parts.prompt: Find the acceleration of the system while the string is taut, and calculate the speed of $B$ at the instant it hits the ground.

parts.label: b
parts.prompt: Find the deceleration of $A$ on the rough section, calculate the distance $A$ travels on the rough section before coming to rest, and determine the total time from initial release until $A$ comes to rest.

questions.prompt: A block $A$ of mass $2\text{ kg}$ lies on a smooth plane inclined at $30^\circ$ to the horizontal. Block $A$ is connected by a light inextensible string passing over a smooth fixed pulley at the top of the incline to a hanging particle $B$ of mass $3\text{ kg}$. The string is parallel to the line of greatest slope. The system is released from rest when $B$ is $0.5\text{ m}$ above horizontal ground. When $B$ hits the ground, it remains at rest and does not rebound.

parts.label: a
parts.prompt: Calculate the acceleration of the system while the string is taut, find the tension in the string, and calculate the speed of $A$ at the instant $B$ hits the ground.

parts.label: b
parts.prompt: Find the deceleration of $A$ after the string becomes slack, and calculate the total distance $A$ moves up the incline from release before coming momentarily to rest, assuming it does not reach the pulley.

questions.prompt: A block $A$ of mass $4\text{ kg}$ rests on a rough horizontal table where the coefficient of friction is $0.25$. Block $A$ is initially $3.2\text{ m}$ from a smooth light pulley fixed at the table edge. It is connected by a light inextensible string passing over the pulley to a hanging particle $B$ of mass $6\text{ kg}$. The hanging particle is initially $0.9\text{ m}$ above horizontal ground. The system is released from rest. When $B$ hits the ground, it remains at rest.

parts.label: a
parts.prompt: Find the acceleration of the system while the string is taut, the tension in the string, and the speed of $A$ at the instant $B$ hits the ground.

parts.label: b
parts.prompt: Calculate the deceleration of $A$ during the slack stage, find the total distance $A$ moves from release until coming to rest, and show that $A$ does not reach the pulley.

questions.prompt: Two particles $A$ of mass $3\text{ kg}$ and $B$ of mass $5\text{ kg}$ are connected by a light inextensible string passing over a smooth fixed pulley. The system is released from rest with both string sections vertical and $B$ at a height of $0.8\text{ m}$ above horizontal ground. When $B$ hits the ground, it remains at rest and the string becomes slack.

parts.label: a
parts.prompt: Find the acceleration of the system while the string is taut, the speed of $A$ at the instant $B$ hits the ground, and the time taken for $B$ to reach the ground.

parts.label: b
parts.prompt: A horizontal ceiling is located $0.15\text{ m}$ directly above the position of particle $A$ at the instant $B$ hits the ground. By calculating the candidate event times for reaching the ceiling and coming to instantaneous rest, determine the earliest event, and find the speed of $A$ at that instant.

questions.prompt: A particle $A$ of mass $1\text{ kg}$ lies on a rough plane inclined at an angle $\theta$ to the horizontal, where $\sin\theta = 0.6$ and $\cos\theta = 0.8$. The coefficient of friction between $A$ and the plane is $0.25$. A light inextensible string attached to $A$ runs parallel to the line of greatest slope, passes over a smooth fixed pulley at the top of the incline, and supports a freely hanging particle $B$ of mass $2\text{ kg}$. The system is released from rest when $B$ is $0.5\text{ m}$ above horizontal ground. When $B$ hits the ground, it remains at rest.

parts.label: a
parts.prompt: Calculate the acceleration of the system while the string is taut, the tension in the string, and the speed of $A$ at the instant $B$ strikes the ground.

parts.label: b
parts.prompt: Show that the deceleration of $A$ while moving up the incline after the string becomes slack is $8\text{ m s}^{-2}$, and calculate the additional distance $A$ moves up the incline before coming momentarily to rest.

parts.label: c
parts.prompt: Determine whether particle $A$ remains at rest at its highest point, and if not, calculate its acceleration down the incline and find the total distance $A$ moved along the incline from release to its highest point.

questions.prompt: A block $A$ of mass $2\text{ kg}$ rests on a rough horizontal table where the coefficient of friction is $0.25$. Block $A$ is connected by a light inextensible string passing over a smooth light pulley fixed at the edge of the table to a hanging particle $B$ of mass $3\text{ kg}$. The string section on the table is horizontal and perpendicular to the edge. The system is released from rest with the string taut, and $B$ descends a distance of $0.9\text{ m}$ before hitting horizontal ground. When $B$ hits the ground, it remains at rest and does not rebound.

parts.label: a
parts.prompt: Show that the acceleration of the system while the string is taut is $5\text{ m s}^{-2}$, find the tension in the string, and calculate the magnitude of the resultant force exerted by the string on the pulley.

parts.label: b
parts.prompt: Calculate the speed of $A$ at the instant $B$ hits the ground, find the deceleration of $A$ while the string is slack, and calculate the distance $A$ would slide from this instant before coming to rest if unobstructed.

parts.label: c
parts.prompt: Suppose block $A$ was initially situated at a distance of $1.9\text{ m}$ from the pulley. Show that block $A$ collides with the pulley, calculate the speed of $A$ at the instant of collision, and find the total time elapsed from initial release until $A$ collides with the pulley.
